mapper.select: /* [판독결과 검토] 검증완료 JSON 헤더(업무 단위) - selectVerifyJsonHeader */ SELECT W.WK_ID AS "wkId" , WM.WK_NM AS "wkNm" , W.TRANS_ID AS "transId" , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(W.SCAN_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "scanDt" FROM OCUOC_OCRWF_L W JOIN ocuoc_ocrwf_m WM ON WM.WK_ID = W.WK_ID WHERE W.TRANS_ID = #{transId} ORDER BY W.SCAN_DT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

/* [판독결과 검토] 검증완료 JSON 항목(A 서식목록 + D 확인값) - selectVerifyJsonItems */ WITH W AS ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT L.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY L.SCAN_DT DESC) AS RN FROM OCUOC_OCRWF_L L WHERE L.TRANS_ID != 'no transaction id' AND L.TRANS_ID = #{transId}) WHERE RN = 1 ), A AS ( SELECT W.WK_ID, WM.WK_NM, W.TRANS_ID, W.SCAN_DT, L.LEFRM_ID, L.LEFRM_NM, O.DOC_ID, O.DOC_TYP_CD, O.DOC_STAT_CD, F.ORG_FILE_NM, F.FILE_EXT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.LEFRM_ID ORDER BY O.ORDINAL, O.DOC_ID) AS DOC_SEQ, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY L.LEFRM_ID) AS DOC_TOTAL FROM W JOIN ocuoc_ocrwf_m WM ON WM.WK_ID = W.WK_ID JOIN ocuoc_ocrwl_l M ON M.WK_ID = W.WK_ID JOIN ocuoc_lefrm_m L ON L.LEFRM_ID = M.LEFRM_ID JOIN OCUOC_OCRDO_L O ON O.TRANS_ID = W.TRANS_ID AND (O.DOC_TYP_CD = L.DOC_ID OR O.DOC_TYP_CD = 'KJB_' || L.DOC_ID) LEFT JOIN OCUOC_OCRIF_L F ON F.REQ_SYS_CD = W.REQ_SYS_CD AND F.SCAN_USER_ID = W.SCAN_USER_ID AND F.SCAN_DPRM_CD = W.SCAN_DPRM_CD AND F.SCAN_DT = W.SCAN_DT AND (F.FILE_NM = O.DOC_NM OR F.ORG_FILE_NM || '.' || F.FILE_EXT = O.DOC_NM) WHERE NVL(LOWER(O.DOC_STAT_CD), ' ') NOT IN ('failed', 'canceled') ) SELECT A.WK_ID AS "wkId", A.WK_NM AS "wkNm", A.TRANS_ID AS "transId", A.LEFRM_ID AS "lefrmId", A.LEFRM_NM AS "lefrmNm", A.DOC_SEQ AS "docSeq", A.DOC_TOTAL AS "docTotal", A.DOC_ID AS "docId", A.ORG_FILE_NM || NVL2(A.FILE_EXT, '.' || A.FILE_EXT, '') AS "fileNm", V.VRFY_STAT_CD AS "vrfyStatCd", X."itemType", X."tblKey", X."rowSeq", X."colNm", X."fildKey", X."recogVal", X."cnfmVal", X."finalVal", X."modYn" FROM A LEFT JOIN OCUOC_OCRVR_L V ON V.TRANS_ID = A.TRANS_ID AND V.DOC_ID = A.DOC_ID JOIN ( SELECT F.DOC_ID, 'F' AS "itemType", NULL AS "tblKey", NULL AS "rowSeq", NULL AS "colNm", F.FILD_KEY AS "fildKey", F.FILD_VAL AS "recogVal", C.CNFM_VAL AS "cnfmVal", CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN F.FILD_VAL ELSE C.CNFM_VAL END AS "finalVal", CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "modYn", 1 AS S1, F.GRP_ID AS S2, 0 AS S3, F.FILD_ID AS S4 FROM OCUOC_OCRDF_L F LEFT JOIN OCUOC_OCRCV_L C ON C.ITEM_TYP_CD = 'F' AND C.ITEM_ID = F.FILD_ID UNION ALL SELECT T.DOC_ID, 'C', T.TBL_KEY, R.ROW_SEQ, TC.COL_NM, R.FILD_KEY, R.FILD_VAL, C.CNFM_VAL, CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN R.FILD_VAL ELSE C.CNFM_VAL END, CASE WHEN C.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, 2, R.TBL_ID, R.ROW_SEQ, NVL(TC.COL_SEQ, 0) FROM OCUOC_OCRDT_L T JOIN OCUOC_OCRTR_L R ON R.TBL_ID = T.TBL_ID LEFT JOIN OCUOC_OCRTC_L TC ON TC.TBL_ID = R.TBL_ID AND TC.COL_ID = R.COL_ID LEFT JOIN OCUOC_OCRCV_L C ON C.ITEM_TYP_CD = 'C' AND C.ITEM_ID = R.CELL_ID ) X ON X.DOC_ID = A.DOC_ID ORDER BY A.LEFRM_ID, A.DOC_SEQ, X.S1, X.S2, X.S3, X.S4
